title: English Web Share Fell From 75% To 45%
hook: English once owned 75% of the web; globalization cut it to 45%.
closing: Using only English now hides nearly half the web from you.
question: Which languages do you browse?

segments.say: English web pages fell from 75% in 1998 to 45% in 2005.
Arabic content grew 2,501% while English grew 281%, reshaping the web.
English now holds 55% of websites; other languages combine for 45%.
